ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The curved arrows need to be ignored in the structural diagram. On the left, an AcO- substituent can be seen, connected via -CH2-CH2- to a conjugated diene chain; the diene chain is connected to a chiral carbon indicated by a bold bond. This chiral carbon forms an O-P-containing cyclic fragment with the adjacent chiral carbon, oxygen, and phosphorus. The upper adjacent chiral carbon bears an EtO2C ethyl ester carbonyl substituent connected by a dashed bond. The phosphorus atom is also connected to a negatively charged oxygen and two ethoxy OEt groups. Reasoning: According to the method draft, start from the ethyl ester substituent written as CCOC(=O)-, and connect into the two-chiral-carbon ring fragment as [C@H]1[C@H](side chain)OP1. The side chain on the second chiral carbon is the trans,trans conjugated diene shown in the figure and connected to -CH2CH2OAc, corresponding to /C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O. The substituents on phosphorus are written according to the figure as [O-] and two ethoxy groups, i.e. P1([O-])(OCC)OCC. Combine and preserve the specified chirality to obtain the target SMILES.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the displayed structure rather than the arrows: start at the ethyl ester substituent EtO2C attached to the upper stereocenter, encode it as CCOC(=O)-, then enter the two-carbon ring segment as [C@H]1[C@H](side chain)O P1. Attach to the second chiral carbon the side chain shown as a trans,trans conjugated diene followed by -CH2CH2OAc, giving /C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O. Complete the ring through O-P, add the P substituents exactly as drawn: one [O-] and two ethoxy groups, P1([O-])(OCC)OCC. Combine these fragments while preserving the indicated stereochemistry to obtain CCOC(=O)[C@H]1[C@H](/C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O)OP1([O-])(OCC)OCC.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：结构图中需要忽略弯箭头。左侧可见 AcO- 取代基，经 -CH2-CH2- 连接到一个共轭二烯链；二烯链连接到一个加粗键表示的手性碳。该手性碳与相邻手性碳、氧和磷形成含 O-P 的环状片段。上方相邻手性碳带有虚线键连接的 EtO2C 乙酯羰基取代基。磷原子上还连接一个带负电的氧以及两个乙氧基 OEt。推理：按方法草案，从乙酯取代基写作 CCOC(=O)-，接入两个手性碳环片段为 [C@H]1[C@H](side chain)OP1。第二个手性碳上的侧链是图中 trans,trans 共轭二烯并接 -CH2CH2OAc，对应 /C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O。磷上的取代基按图写为 [O-] 和两个乙氧基，即 P1([O-])(OCC)OCC。合并并保留指定手性得到目标 SMILES。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-isomeric-SMILES route: read the whole displayed transition-state skeleton as a static molecule, ignore only the curved arrows, and encode the observed connectivity, double-bond geometry, charge, and stereochemistry. No alternative independent reasoning route is needed for this single structure-recognition task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the molecular graph: a five-membered cyclic phosphorane/phosphate transition-state core containing P bonded to an anionic O, two ethoxy substituents, an O in the ring, and two adjacent chiral carbons; one ring carbon bears an ethoxycarbonyl group shown with hashed stereochemistry, and the other bears a conjugated diene side chain ending in an acetate ester. Ignore the curved arrows drawn near P/O and keep the wedge/hash bonds and E/Z alkene slash directions implied by the drawing.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to determine the requested output format: provide the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and ignore the curved arrows in the image.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply standard organic structure-to-SMILES conventions: EtO2C is CCOC(=O)-, AcO is -OC(C)=O, (OEt)2 on phosphorus gives two OCC substituents, a negatively charged oxygen is [O-], stereocenters are encoded with [C@H]/[C@@H] according to the drawing orientation, and drawn trans alkene geometry is represented with /C=C/ notation. Then choose a valid traversal of the ring and substituents to produce an isomeric SMILES.
